traits.name: Deflecting Gale
traits.text: ⬲ (air, evocation, primal); Requirements The sylph sneak is aware of the attack Trigger The sylph sneak is the target of a physical ranged attack Effect A swift gale whips up between the sylph sneak and the source of the ranged attack, giving the sneak a +3 status bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If the attack misses, the wind deflected it. The wind can't deflect unusually large or heavy ranged projectiles (such as boulders or ballista bolts).

traits.name: Sneak Attack
traits.text: The sylph sneak's Strikes deal 1d6 (1d6) extra precision damage to flat-footed creatures.

traits.name: Surprise Attacker
traits.text: On the first round of combat, creatures that haven't acted yet are flat-footed to the sylph sneak.

traits.name: Wind's Guidance
traits.text: When the sylph sneak attacks with a thrown weapon, the range increment increases by 10 feet.
